categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of electronic components, including connectors, cable assemblies, and electronic modules under the CviLux brand. It serves industries such as networking, laptops, optoelectronics, digital consumer electronics, automotive, and industrial applications. Additionally, it develops IoT products, wireless modules, smart home appliances, healthcare accessories, automotive electronics, digital currency storage devices, and system integration services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies including micro-pitch high-frequency transmission flexible cable connectors, waterproof and high-power connectors, and high-reliability automotive connectors. It emphasizes automation, digital transformation with MES, WMS, SCADA systems, AI-driven decision-making, and smart manufacturing platforms. The production process includes precision molding, stamping, plating, assembly, and automated inspection to ensure high quality and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global electronic product manufacturers across Asia, Europe, and America, especially in the networking, consumer electronics, automotive, industrial, and IoT sectors. The company serves top 100 global EMS providers and targets markets such as data centers, electric vehicles, 5G infrastructure, and industrial automation. It also focuses on expanding in the US and Latin American markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing and sales facilities in Taiwan, China (Dongguan, Suzhou, Chongqing, Shenzhen), Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Laos), South Korea, and the United States. Sales are distributed globally with significant revenue from China, Taiwan, Vietnam, Belgium, Italy, Germany, France, and other countries. It has established a diversified production base to enhance supply chain resilience and market responsiveness.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing electronic connectors, cable assemblies, and modules. It sources raw materials such as metals and plastics from multiple suppliers and integrates upstream processes like plating and molding. It also engages in downstream activities including product customization, system integration, and direct sales to OEMs and EMS providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing digital transformation, AI integration, and smart manufacturing to improve production efficiency and product quality. R&D focuses on developing high-frequency, high-power, waterproof connectors, automotive-grade components, and flexible flat cables. The company invests in green energy, energy-saving products, and sustainable manufacturing practices aligned with ESG principles. It plans to expand product lines into new applications such as AIoT and renewable energy.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of connectors, cable assemblies, electronic modules, and related components. The company also earns income from system integration services, consulting, and sales of smart home and healthcare devices. It maintains long-term supply contracts with major customers and leverages global distribution networks to maximize sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a highly fragmented and competitive connector industry dominated by global giants like TE Connectivity, Amphenol, and Molex. It differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, product quality, and customization services. Chinese manufacturers are significant competitors, especially in low-end products, but the company focuses on high-end, high-reliability markets to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$31.88 billion, a 7.76% increase from the previous year, and a net profit of NT$3.38 billion, up 57.02%. It has a stable financial structure with a debt ratio of 30.10% and strong equity growth. The company invests around 4% of revenue annually in R&D and maintains steady growth in profitability and earnings per share.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, reliable, and customized electronic connectors and cable assemblies that meet stringent international standards and customer specifications. It integrates advanced manufacturing automation and digital management to ensure product consistency and cost efficiency. Commitment to ESG and sustainable practices enhances its appeal as a green supply chain partner. Its broad product portfolio and global presence enable it to provide comprehensive, one-stop solutions to customers.
